articles.title: Record-Breaking Splashes and Surprise Comebacks at the Sette Colli Trophy!
articles.summary: Sara Curtis smashed a European record in the 50 backstroke after almost being disqualified! The Italian swimmer came back to win in 27.07 seconds. Big names like Adam Peaty missed the final, setting up exciting underdog races.

articles.title: This Super-Bright Security Camera Is at Its Cheapest Price Ever!
articles.summary: The Eufy E340 floodlight camera can light up your whole backyard with 2,000 lumens—that's like having two car headlights on your house! It has two lenses to zoom in on faces 50 feet away, and you don't need a monthly subscription.

articles.title: Which Swim Meet Will Be the Fastest This Year? Fans Have a Clear Favorite!
articles.summary: Almost 60% of SwimSwam readers think the Pan Pacific Championships will have the fastest races this summer. Why? Superstars like Summer McIntosh will be there, and most top women swimmers are from the USA, Australia, or Canada.
